title: 6th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of two previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/2/2025 to 2/2/2025).

Question time: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir asks Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed why the minimum wage has not been reviewed, given that the Employment Act requires the minister's minimum-wage figure to be reviewed every 2 years and more than 3 years have passed since January 2022, and when the minimum wage will be revised and raised.

Question time: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir asks Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed why the regulations required within 3 months under the Industrial Relations Act are still not made after more than a year, whether people losing their legal rights through this delay matters to him, and on what date the regulations will be made and gazetted.
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Ihavandhoo MP Ahmed Naseer to amend Law No. 4/2012 (Thalassaemia Control Act).
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad to amend Law No. 8/2025 (Attorney General's Office Act).

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal to gauge members' views on the rules for paying education-sector and health-sector workers for overtime work and on establishing a fair working environment.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting put two questions to the labour minister on the overdue minimum-wage review and missing Industrial Relations Act regulations, introduced the Thalassaemia Control and Attorney General's Office amendment bills, and opened debate on the overtime-pay resolution.
